t.zh: 已知物体的实际高度和距离，并测得它在照片中占据的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>数，能否估计镜头的<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>？照片给出的是像素数，而<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>关系需要<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上的实际长度。
t.en: If an object’s height and distance are known and its size in the photograph is measured in <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>, can the lens’s <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> be estimated? The photograph gives a pixel count, while <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref> requires a physical length on the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>和毫米怎样换算，才能代进<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>？<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>高 smm 毫米、spx 像素；物体在图里高 hpx 像素，实际高 H、距离 Z（毫米）。
t.en: This level asks: how are <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> and millimetres converted before the <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>? The <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> is smm millimetres and spx samples high; the object covers hpx samples and is H tall and Z away, in millimetres.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>：先把<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>换成<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上的毫米，再代进 h/f = H/Z。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>: convert <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> to millimetres on the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> first, then h/f = H/Z; pixel counts and millimetres never share a proportion.

brief.zh: 输入 hpx、spx、smm、Z、H：交出<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f（毫米）。
brief.en: Given hpx, spx, smm, Z and H, give the <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f in millimetres.

hint.zh: 一个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>在<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上有多少毫米？
hint.en: How many millimetres of <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> is one <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>?
